name: magic-link
title: Magic link sign-in
description: Passwordless sign-in by email: single use links stored hashed, 15 minute expiry, per email cooldown, redirect allowlist, links bound to the browser that asked. Lockout, disabled accounts and 2FA (totp) still apply.
author: CalmAPI
docs:
1. POST /api/auth/magic-link { email, redirect? } -> 202 { message, requestId, expiresIn } (same answer whether or not the account exists). Keep requestId in localStorage.
2. The email links to APP_URL/auth/magic?token=... (option linkUrl). That page calls POST /api/auth/magic-link/verify { token, requestId } -> { token, user, expiresAt, redirect? }, or { mfaRequired, mfaToken } when 2FA is on.
Options (calm.config.js blocks['magic-link']): createAccount, requireSameDevice, allowedRedirects, ttlMinutes, cooldownSeconds, linkUrl.
